page_title: UNI 0-3 EIN | Union Berlin v Eintracht Frankfurt 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Sven Jablonski due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) and his team.
85' Substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe did his best and is replaced by Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt).
83' Here is a change. Christopher Trimmel is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Volland (Union Berlin).
83' Substitution. Leonardo Bonucci will be replaced by Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Sheraldo Becker.
82' 0 - 3 Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
74' Substitution. Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Omar Marmoush.
74' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Fares Chaibi.
73' Here comes a substitution. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Alex Kral.
73' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
71' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
71' Flag up against Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
68' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
63' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Ansgar Knauff is replaced by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
60' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but it's cleared.

59' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Kevin Trapp pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. The referee signals a corner kick to Union Berlin.
56' That will be all from Benedict Hollerbach who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin).
56' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
51' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
47' The resulting corner, taken by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), comes to nothing.

47' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
47' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) works the corner short.

47' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Union Berlin are going to take it.
46' Dino Toppmoller has made a change at the break. Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) has come on in place of Tuta.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes a short corner kick.
43' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
41' The resulting corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes to nothing.
38' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
37' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

37' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Union Berlin can continue in their attacking effort.
34' The corner kick from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
29' Yellow card. Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
28' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is flagged for offside.
20' It should have been a goal! David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
14' 0 - 2 Hugo Larsson provides Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
11' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Kevin Trapp.
8' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

8' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Union Berlin will take a corner kick.
6' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

2' 0 - 1 Goal! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Frederik Ronnow is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:1.
2' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Eintracht Frankfurt will take the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will referee today's match.
